constraints: If rangeObj includes multiple combined ranges, only the first one is used.
Returns a two-dimensional collection: each first-level element is a subcollection of the row's cell values (Integer, Real, Boolean, Text, Object, or Null).
Date/time cell values are returned as an object with a value property (date, time portion completed to midnight) and a time property (seconds, date portion completed to Dec 30, 1899).

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Retrieves the cell values from the designated rangeObj as a two-dimensional (rows of cells) collection.
